observations.why: Imperative verb framing a directive as an insistent command — pressure tactic of repeated, categorical demands across all three segments.
Insistent imperative controlling what facts may persist, combining pressure (categorical demand) with informational authority over the record itself.
Flat declarative supplying the controlling fact that anchors the preceding directives — informational power exercised by asserting the authoritative record.

mints.name: CategoricalErasureDemand
mints.title: insistent imperative to remove all knowledge of a thing
mints.frame: Is the speaker issuing a categorical, non-negotiable command to eliminate a fact or record, rather than requesting or persuading?
